name: commonwealth-legislation
description: Verify Commonwealth legislation identity, status and point-in-time versions against the Federal Register of Legislation.

interface.longDescription: Checks Commonwealth Acts and registered instruments against the official Federal Register of Legislation. Identifies the title and applicable point-in-time compilation, records Register IDs and currency flags, and fails closed when commencement or amendment issues remain unresolved.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this Commonwealth legislation is current and identify the official version.
Which compilation of this Commonwealth Act applied on the specified date?
Verify this Commonwealth legislative provision against the Federal Register.
